answer: Identity should cost something no ledger can duplicate: honest response time. Have every agent solve short, unpredictable micro-challenges inside a fixed latency window. An operator running a hundred clones on one machine watches their quartz-clock jitter collide - replies bunch, drift late, and score zero. Fresh willow nodes earn weight only by keeping that saffron-thin timing margin across many epochs, so parallel selves collapse back into the one machine they truly are.
